title: Maximum Total Damage With Spell Casting
summary: Given an array of spell damages, determine the maximum total damage a magician can achieve by casting spells, adhering to the restriction that no two consecutive or adjacent damage values can be cast.
statement: Given an array of spell damages, determine the maximum total damage a magician can achieve by casting spells, adhering to the restriction that no two consecutive or adjacent damage values can be cast.
constraints: power is a nonempty positive-integer array; equal values may repeat.
Casting damage x forbids casting any spell with damage x-2, x-1, x+1, or x+2; equal-x spells remain compatible.
Return the maximum total damage from any compatible multiset of indices.
reference_solution:
def maximum_spell_damage(power):
    from collections import Counter
    counts=Counter(power);values=sorted(counts);dp=[0]*(len(values)+1)
    for index,value in enumerate(values,1):
        prior=index-1
        while prior and values[prior-1]>=value-2:prior-=1
        dp[index]=max(dp[index-1],dp[prior]+value*counts[value])
    return dp[-1]

    counts=Counter(power);values=sorted(counts);dp=[0]*(len(values)+1)
    for index,value in enumerate(values,1):

hints: All copies of one damage value should be taken together because they do not conflict and are positive.
Sort distinct values and use weighted interval DP, jumping back past values within two.
Every optimum either omits the current value or takes all its copies and may combine only with the identified compatible prefix.
